tagline: Lakehouse Real Time warehouse support (Beta): AI/BI dashboards now work with Lakehouse Real Time SQL warehouses.
what_it_does: Lakehouse Real Time warehouse support (Beta): AI/BI dashboards now work with Lakehouse Real Time SQL warehouses. Dashboard Insights (Beta): Viewers can now have Genie analyze the charts on a published dashboard page and summarize notable findings, such as trends and outliers, as insight cards. Import Power BI .tmdl files: Authors can now upload Power BI .tmdl files to create metric views with the /importBI Genie Code skill.
why_it_matters: This page explains how to customize dashboard settings and themes to match your organization's branding, improve readability, and ensure consistent data presentation across different regions and languages.
